guard: every workflow a push to main can start either queues its runs or has no concurrency group at all, and no workflow can reach the queue:max plus cancel-in-progress:true pairing that fails validation
why: The property this suite guards is only observable on main AFTER a merge: a pull_request run
evaluates the PR branch of every expression and never touches the main grouping. So the suite
cannot be validated by the pull request that changes it, and CI going green proves nothing
about it. That is the whole reason the guard is static, and it is also why the guard itself
needs mutation proof rather than a green run.
The three mutations are the three ways this has actually gone wrong or could go wrong silently.
M1 restores the short `concurrency: <string>` form. This is the shape changesets.yml and
installer.yml sat in, and it is the dangerous one precisely because it reads as a deliberate
minimal choice while selecting cancel-in-progress false and queue single, the evicting
defaults. A reader scanning for a wrong VALUE finds nothing to object to.
M2 forces queue to a literal max where cancel-in-progress is still event-conditional. On
pull_request that resolves to max plus true, which is a workflow VALIDATION error, so the file
stops running rather than misbehaving. It is checked per event because both keys are
conditional and no per-file glance can see a combination that only one event produces.
M3 replaces the expression with a form the reader does not know. It must FAIL rather than be
skipped. A reader that silently ignores what it cannot parse is how a guard turns into a green
that means nothing, which is the failure mode this repo has hit more than once.

mutations.name: changesets.yml goes back to the short concurrency form
mutations.find:
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
  queue: max
mutations.cell: uses the mapping form, so it can carry

mutations.name: windows.yml queue becomes a literal max, pairing with cancel-in-progress true on pull_request
mutations.expectRed: windows.yml: on pull_request, not (queue=max AND cancel-in-progress=true)

mutations.name: installer.yml queue uses an expression form the reader does not recognise
mutations.expectRed: installer.yml: `queue` is a form this check understands
mutations.cell: is a form this check understands
